exposure: Women with IBD vs. women without IBD
cohort: 630,742 women who delivered at ≥20 weeks of gestation in New South Wales, Australia, from 2001-2011
finding: Pregnancies complicated by IBD at or near the time of birth have significantly higher rates of adverse pregnancy outcomes, such as cesarean section, severe maternal morbidity, and preterm birth, compared to pregnancies of women without IBD.
mod_finding: Women with inflammatory bowel disease had significantly higher rates of cesarean section compared to women without inflammatory bowel disease.
